dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Ugh! I failed again... The disgrace of it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Tenryou Commission...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: As you can see, the times have changed. The Tenryou Commission is currently redeploying its defenses all across Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Though we're not as efficient or brave as Madam Kujou Sara makes us out to be, we spare no effort in protecting Inazuma and stopping these monsters from ravaging the land...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: I knew we could count on Madam Kujou Sara! The reinforcements she sent are all seasoned veterans!

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: With experienced fighters on hand, no amount of monsters can breach this pass!

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Ha, nothing more than a scratch! Tenryou Commission samurai don't back down in critical moments like these!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a valiant spirit! No wonder people are starting to feel more at ease!

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: The situation seems to be stabilizing... Madam Kujou Sara won't feel pressured to take action.

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: No need to rush. We'll launch a general offensive as soon as Madam Kujou Sara finishes with her business in the city, and take down this Domain in one go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should hurry, they seem pretty amped up...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Those who seek ultimate attainment, can find it in practices of this Mystic Onmyou Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Of course, rushing straight for the strongest opponent may set you back. Know yourself, and proceed in accordance with your abilities.
